t: Give your winter trees and bushes a festive glow. Spruce Leaves can combined with Lights in a crafting table to create Leaves with Lights. $(br2)To make the large light versions, use Classic base lights. To make the regular sized versions, use Tree Lights.
为你的冬日树木与灌木增添节日光彩吧！云杉树叶可在工作台中与灯具组合，制成带灯树叶。$(br2)制作大型灯效版本请使用经典基础灯具；制作常规尺寸版本请使用树形灯具。
